definitions.explanation: Something of superior quality or higher value than the standard version. Widely used in marketing and product branding to indicate a luxury or upgraded option.

examples.japanese: プレミアムな{体験|たいけん}ができる。
examples.english: You can have a premium experience.

examples.japanese: プレミアム{会員|かいいん}になると{特典|とくてん}がつく。
examples.english: If you become a premium member, you get special benefits.

examples.japanese: {限定|げんてい}のプレミアムモデルは{通常|つうじょう}{版|ばん}より{倍|ばい}の{値段|ねだん}がする。
examples.english: The limited premium model costs twice as much as the regular version.

notes:
USAGE:
プレミアム is one of the most common marketing buzzwords in Japan. It is used as both a noun (プレミアムがつく = a premium is added) and a na-adjective modifier (プレミアムな = premium/luxurious). プレミアムフライデー was a government initiative (since 2017) encouraging early departure from work on the last Friday of each month.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- プレミアム{会員|かいいん}: premium member
- プレミアムモデル: premium model
- プレミアム{商品|しょうひん}: premium product
- プレミアムがつく: a premium is attached (price goes above face value)
- プレミアムフライデー: Premium Friday (government campaign)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{高級|こうきゅう} (high-class/luxury) is the native equivalent. プレミアム sounds more modern and marketing-oriented.
